availability.note: CarsGuide lists the 2026 Junior Elettrica Series 1 'New: Available to order' at $58,990 RRP. Alfa AU model page (https://www.alfaromeo.com.au/models/junior) is live with Ibrida and Elettrica and 'configure' links, but the configurator renders client-side and /selector-pricing serves empty msrp fields, so no manufacturer price or grade count could be read. One battery-electric grade on CarExpert's Series 1 (release 1 Dec 2025) page; the older 20250402 CarExpert entry ($55,900) is Series 0 stock.

listPrice.note: CarExpert Series 1 spec page: 'from $58,990 before on-road costs' (Sydney drive-away $64,057, gap consistent with a list price). CarsGuide Series 1 $58,990 RRP agrees. Launch $57,900 (July 2025) and Series 0 $55,900 are superseded. No manufacturer price readable (configurator client-side). Unchanged from held.

batteryKwh.note: ADAC: brutto 54,0 kWh, netto 51,0 kWh (Elettrica 156, same 115kW powertrain). CarExpert AU: 54 kWh gross / 51 usable; EV Database 54.0 nominal / 50.8 usable. Alfa AU's '54kWh' is gross.

rangeKm.note: Alfa AU model page '407km (WLTP)' on the AU 18-inch Petali wheels. Direction test: below the European WLTP 410 km on 215/55R18 (ADAC, CarExpert), so not an NEDC submission; accepted. EV Database band 398-412.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: ADAC WLTP Stromverbrauch kombiniert 15,1 kWh/100km on 215/55R18 (wall-plug, includes charging losses). Held 15.2 had no record and is replaced. batteryKwh/rangeKm x 100 = 12.5, 17% under 15.1, inside the 25% cross-check.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: Maker figure 400 L seats up (CarExpert AU, Alfa AU model page, ADAC catalogue). ADAC's own measurement (Autotest PDF) is 295 L to the parcel shelf and 410 L to the roof, so the maker's 400 may be closer to a roof-height figure; kept as the maker's figure for consistency with siblings' maker figures. Frunk: none.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: Maker 1,265 L is to the roof (ADAC catalogue 'dachhoch'), against the belt-line convention. ADAC Autotest measured 685 L folded to the window line (and 295 L seats-up to the shelf). Scaled to the maker's seats-up basis: 685 x 400/295 = 929. Unscaled ADAC figure 685 is the alternative.

seats.note: CarExpert: rear seating capacity 3, two front; five seats.

towKg.note: EV Database: tow hitch not possible, 0 kg braked/unbraked. ADAC lists 'keine Anhängelast'. No AU tow figure published.

warrantyYears.note: Alfa AU: five years, no kilometre limit; no servicing condition stated. Battery 8 yr/160,000 km per CarExpert cost-of-ownership page.

insuranceAnnual.note: Kept. Anchored to jeep-avenger-summit (same platform, $60,990, 1900) and mini-aceman-se-favoured ($60,990, 2000).

depreciationCurve.note: One curve per brand: matches alfa-romeo-tonale-phev exactly (also jeep-avenger). Steeper than mainstream default for thin Alfa volume, an eight-dealer network and Stellantis EV discounting on the Avenger twin.
